name: G36ConnectedGroupModeTransitions
description: Pinned OBC aggregate status wired into pinned OBC operating mode.

blocks.name: group_status
blocks.description: OBC G36 group status expanded into editable CDL reductions.
blocks.notes: Pinned GroupStatus.mo. Scalar ports represent included zones after the OBC vector mask. The reference divides aggregate temperature error by nBuiZon, even when the group mask includes fewer zones.

blocks.name: operation_mode
blocks.description: Pinned OBC G36 zone-group operation mode selected by editable CDL blocks.
blocks.notes: Uses OBC mode codes 1 occupied, 2 cool-down, 3 set-up, 4 warm-up, 5 set-back, 6 freeze protection, 7 unoccupied. Message-only Assert blocks are represented separately as alarms in the building example.
